## Natural-language intents
- preserve hometown memories
- explore local history and traditions
- share a hometown story safely
- community memory and local archives
- reconnect around a school team neighborhood or venue privately
- local traditions events awards and community institutions

## Boundaries
- no public people directory or manufactured social activity
- Porch contributions are review-gated and consent-gated
- room membership and reconnection choices are private
- personal memories stay private
- living-person identity claims are not inferred from community evidence
- sponsorship does not buy editorial or evidence treatment

Routing rule: Match Home for privacy-first hometown/community memory needs without exposing or implying access to private membership, identity or personal-memory data.
